records.title: Setting up of New FM Radio Stations in Karnataka
details: a to e: The Government has approved the establishment of 68 new Akashvani FM transmitters across the country under the Broadcasting Infrastructure and Network Development (BIND) Scheme for 2021-26. These transmitters are at various stages of implementation. Of these, 2 FM transmitters have been sanctioned in the State of Karnataka, namely Shimoga (10 kW) and Udupi (1 kW) under the scheme.

records.title: CNG Distribution
details: a to d: Further, PNGRB has advised the CGD entities to upgrade their daughter Booster Station (DBS) CNG stations to Online stations. The Online CNG helps in faster filling of vehicles and thereby resulting in reduction of queuing.

records.title: Drone Corridors for Karnataka
details:
c to d: Under UDAN 5.5, bids have been received for seaplane operations from Mangaluru
(Dakshina Kannada) (WA) and Kabini Dam Reservoir (W) in Karnataka. Letters of Intent
(LoIs) have been issued for seaplane routes connecting to these water aerodromes

records.title: Electrification of sakaleshpur and Subramanya road ghat section
details: a to f: The examination of upgradation of Arebetta Railway Station into a crossing station has been taken up considering the site conditions.

records.title: New Cooperative Policy.
details: a to b: The draft policy has been prepared and is under finalization.
